package repository

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"generationfixture/dao"
	"generationfixture/model"
	gormplus "github.com/kuangshp/gorm-plus"
	"github.com/kuangshp/gorm-plus/query"
	"gorm.io/driver/sqlite"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

var startupItemsRepository = NewItemsRepository() // 模拟业务包在数据库初始化前创建仓储。
var startupNotesRepository = NewNotesRepository() // 并发首次使用时仍需只绑定一个连接。

func TestRepositoryBeforeDatabaseInitialization(t *testing.T) { // 独立进程验证两种启动方式，避免其他测试的默认连接影响结果。
	mode := os.Getenv("GORMPLUS_REPOSITORY_STARTUP_MODE")
	if mode == "" {
		for _, mode := range []string{"legacy", "default", "unmanaged"} {
			t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
				command := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestRepositoryBeforeDatabaseInitialization$", "-test.v")
				command.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GORMPLUS_REPOSITORY_STARTUP_MODE="+mode)
				if output, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("startup mode %s: %v\n%s", mode, err, output)
				}
			})
		}
		return
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	if _, err := startupItemsRepository.Count(ctx); !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrInvalidDB) {
		t.Fatalf("uninitialized connection: %v", err)
	}
	open := func(name string) *gorm.DB {
		t.Helper()
		db, err := gorm.Open(sqlite.Open(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), name+".db")))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		conn, err := db.DB()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Cleanup(func() { conn.Close() })
		for _, table := range []string{"items", "notes"} {
			if err := db.Exec("CREATE TABLE " + table + " (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, deleted_at DATETIME)").Error; err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := db.Exec("INSERT INTO "+table+" (id, name) VALUES (1, ?)", name).Error; err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		return db
	}
	primary := open("primary")
	switch mode {
	case "legacy":
		dao.SetDefault(primary)
	case "default":
		gormplus.Use(primary)
	case "unmanaged":
		tx := primary.Begin()
		if tx.Error != nil {
			t.Fatal(tx.Error)
		}
		defer tx.Rollback()
		dao.SetDefault(tx)
		if _, err := startupItemsRepository.Count(ctx); !errors.Is(err, gormplus.ErrUnmanagedTransaction) {
			t.Fatalf("lazy binding accepted unmanaged transaction: %v", err)
		}
		return
	default:
		t.Fatalf("unexpected startup mode %q", mode)
	}
	if row, err := startupItemsRepository.FindById(ctx, 1); err != nil || row.Name != "primary" {
		t.Fatalf("early repository failed after initialization: %+v %v", row, err)
	}
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for range 20 {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			if row, err := startupNotesRepository.FindById(ctx, 1); err != nil || row.Name != "primary" {
				t.Errorf("concurrent first binding: %+v %v", row, err)
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	other := open("other")
	gormplus.Use(other)
	if row, err := startupItemsRepository.FindById(ctx, 1); err != nil || row.Name != "primary" {
		t.Fatalf("late default switch changed bound items repository: %+v %v", row, err)
	}
	if row, err := startupNotesRepository.FindById(ctx, 1); err != nil || row.Name != "primary" {
		t.Fatalf("late default switch changed bound notes repository: %+v %v", row, err)
	}
}

func TestThreeRepositoryDataSources(t *testing.T) {
	dbs := []*gorm.DB{transactionDB(t), transactionDB(t), transactionDB(t)}
	gormplus.Use(dbs[0])
	// 新默认连接与旧全局 DAO 不同时，以 Use 注册的连接为准。
	dao.SetDefault(dbs[2])
	repos := []ItemsRepository{NewItemsRepository(), NewItemsRepository(dbs[1]), NewItemsRepository(dbs[2])}
	ctx := context.Background()
	cached := query.Query().WithCache(time.Minute).Build()
	var counts [3]atomic.Int64
	for i, db := range dbs {
		index := i
		if err := db.Callback().Query().Before("gorm:query").Register("count_reads", func(*gorm.DB) { counts[index].Add(1) }); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := repos[i].Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 1, Name: fmt.Sprintf("db-%d", i)}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	check := func(i int, name string) {
		t.Helper()
		row, err := repos[i].FindById(ctx, 1, cached)
		if err != nil || row.Name != name {
			t.Fatalf("source %d: row=%+v err=%v", i, row, err)
		}
	}
	for i := range repos {
		check(i, fmt.Sprintf("db-%d", i))
	}
	// 相同表、主键和查询参数也必须在并发命中时保持数据源隔离。
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for i := range repos {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(i int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			for n := 0; n < 50; n++ {
				row, err := repos[i].FindById(ctx, 1, cached)
				if err != nil || row.Name != fmt.Sprintf("db-%d", i) {
					t.Errorf("source %d cache crossed: %+v %v", i, row, err)
					return
				}
			}
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	before0, before2 := counts[0].Load(), counts[2].Load()
	if err := repos[1].UpdateMapById(ctx, 1, map[string]any{"name": "db-1-updated"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	check(0, "db-0")
	check(1, "db-1-updated")
	check(2, "db-2")
	if counts[0].Load() != before0 || counts[2].Load() != before2 {
		t.Fatal("one source invalidated another source's cache")
	}
	// 条件更新的整表失效也只影响对应数据源。
	if err := repos[1].UpdateByWrapper(ctx, func(w gormplus.IGenWrapper[dao.IItemsEntityDo]) {
		w.Where(dao.ItemsEntity.ID.Eq(1))
	}, gormplus.WithUpdateColumns(dao.ItemsEntity.Name.Value("db-1-wrapper"))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	check(0, "db-0")
	check(1, "db-1-wrapper")
	check(2, "db-2")
	if counts[0].Load() != before0 || counts[2].Load() != before2 {
		t.Fatal("table invalidation crossed sources")
	}
	abort := errors.New("abort")
	err := gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, dbs[1], dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
		bound := repos[1].WithTx(tx)
		if err := bound.UpdateMapById(ctx, 1, map[string]any{"name": "uncommitted"}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		row, err := bound.FindById(ctx, 1, cached)
		if err != nil || row.Name != "uncommitted" {
			t.Fatalf("bound source lost: %+v %v", row, err)
		}
		// 也支持把本库创建的事务 *gorm.DB 直接传给构造函数。
		direct := NewItemsRepository(tx.ItemsEntity.UnderlyingDB())
		row, err = direct.FindById(ctx, 1, cached)
		if err != nil || row.Name != "uncommitted" {
			t.Fatalf("constructor transaction lost: %+v %v", row, err)
		}
		return abort
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, abort) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	check(0, "db-0")
	check(1, "db-1-wrapper")
	check(2, "db-2")
	if err := gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, dbs[1], dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
		return repos[1].WithTx(tx).UpdateMapById(ctx, 1, map[string]any{"name": "committed"})
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	check(0, "db-0")
	check(1, "committed")
	check(2, "db-2")
	// 更新默认连接只作用于之后构造的仓储，不改变已存在的实例。
	gormplus.Use(dbs[2])
	check(0, "db-0")
	latest := NewItemsRepository()
	row, err := latest.FindById(ctx, 1, cached)
	if err != nil || row.Name != "db-2" {
		t.Fatalf("new default ignored: %+v %v", row, err)
	}
	type joinRow struct {
		ID   int64
		Name string
	}
	joined, err := FindItemsJoinList[joinRow](ctx, nil, nil, cached)
	if err != nil || len(joined) != 1 || joined[0].Name != "db-2" {
		t.Fatalf("default join ignored Use: %+v %v", joined, err)
	}
	for _, args := range [][]*gorm.DB{{nil}, {dbs[0], dbs[1]}} {
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if recover() == nil {
					t.Error("invalid constructor accepted")
				}
			}()
			NewItemsRepository(args...)
		}()
	}
}
